record.paper_title: TWISTED GGP PROBLEMS AND CONJECTURES, GGP IV
record.original_question: Can the existing methods developed for the original Gan-Gross-Prasad conjectures in the Hermitian or untwisted setting be adapted to the twisted Gan-Gross-Prasad setting for skew-Hermitian spaces, in particular the integral formulas for branching multiplicities and the Jacquet-Rallis relative trace formula comparisons that underlie proofs of branching and period conjectures?

evidence.quote: With the twisted GGP problems and conjectures formulated, one can ask if all the previous work that has been done for the GGP conjectures can be adapted to this twisted setting. These include Waldspurger’s and Beuzart-Plessis’s integral formulae for the branching multiplicity and comparison of Jacquet-Rallis relative trace formulae, which in the skew-Hermitian case is due to Y.F. Liu [L] and H. Xue [X1, X2].

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Setup. Let $E/F$ be a quadratic extension of number fields (or local fields) with nontrivial Galois involution $c$. A skew-Hermitian space $(V,\langle\,,\,\rangle)$ over $E$ is a finite-dimensional $E$-vector space equipped with a nondegenerate sesquilinear form satisfying $\langle x,y\rangle = -\overline{\langle y,x\rangle}$. Let $U(V)$ denote the associated unitary group.

In the (untwisted) Gan–Gross–Prasad framework for skew-Hermitian spaces, given a pair $W\subset V$ one studies Fourier–Jacobi periods on $U(W)\times U(V)$ and a relative-trace-formula comparison à la Jacquet–Rallis, together with local integral formulas (in the style of Waldspurger and Beuzart-Plessis) expressing the branching multiplicity
$$m(\pi,\sigma) = \dim\mathrm{Hom}_{U(W)}(\pi\otimes\sigma,\omega_{\psi})$$
as an explicit integral over a regular semisimple locus. These tools underlie the proofs of the local and global GGP conjectures in the skew-Hermitian setting due to Y. Liu and H. Xue.

In the twisted Gan–Gross–Prasad setting one considers, for a skew-Hermitian space $V$ over $E$, the pair $(U(V), U(V)\times_F E^\times)$ (or its analogue involving the diagonal embedding twisted by characters of $E^\times$), and one formulates analogous local branching and global period conjectures.

Problem. Develop, in the twisted Gan–Gross–Prasad setting for skew-Hermitian spaces, the analogues of:

(i) a Waldspurger / Beuzart-Plessis-type integral formula expressing the local twisted branching multiplicity as an explicit orbital integral over a regular semisimple geometric quotient;

(ii) a Jacquet–Rallis-type relative trace formula and a comparison of relative trace formulae that yields the global twisted period identity.

Equivalently: prove the local and global twisted Gan–Gross–Prasad conjectures for skew-Hermitian spaces by adapting these two technologies from the untwisted skew-Hermitian case.
artifact.status_search_result: The twisted GGP conjectures for skew-Hermitian spaces remain largely open, but substantial progress has been made. Recent work (e.g. Beuzart-Plessis–Chaudouard–Zydor-type techniques and papers by Xue–Zhang on twisted linear periods and a new RTF, and a 2023/2025 preprint on the twisted GGP conjecture for unramified quadratic extensions and on central values of Asai L-functions and twisted GGP) has adapted parts of the integral-formula and relative-trace-formula machinery to the twisted setting, yielding the conjecture under local hypotheses. A full adaptation matching the untwisted skew-Hermitian results of Liu and Xue is not yet available.

status_evidence.title: Twisted Gan–Gross–Prasad conjecture for unramified quadratic extensions
status_evidence.snippet: Proves cases of the twisted GGP conjecture using relative trace formula methods under unramifiedness assumptions.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results on twisted GGP via RTF comparison.

status_evidence.title: Twisted linear periods and a new relative trace formula (Xue–Zhang)
status_evidence.snippet: Develops a new relative trace formula adapted to twisted period problems.
status_evidence.claim: New RTF tools are being developed for twisted settings.

status_evidence.title: Central values of Asai L-functions and twisted Gan–Gross–Prasad conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: Recent progress relating Asai L-values to twisted GGP periods.
